description: Turn any project's CHANGELOG.md text, or a GitHub release, releases page, repository or changelog file URL, into a machine-readable changelog: versions, dates, breaking changes with migration steps, and deprecations. Works for projects that aren't on LogPulse. Returns an llms.txt-style summary plus structured JSON.

include_notes.description: Include each release's full notes in the JSON. Default false to keep the answer short.

markdown.description: The changelog text itself, e.g. the contents of CHANGELOG.md. Use this or url.

name.description: Project name to use in the summary.

url.description: GitHub URL: a release (github.com/owner/repo/releases/tag/v1.2.0), the releases page, a repository, or a CHANGELOG.md file. Use this or markdown.

name: convert_changelog
title: Convert a changelog
